Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. rationale: The local Step requires destination freshness and Eval, then binds the result and retains rest. baseOperation selects this relation. Framed.Step.local collects running after/rest, while exit accepts running state [] and collects the same heap/counter with no frame. These match both equations and the distinction between local observation and public program transitions. Freshness is checked against evaluation storage, and expressions remain atomic. patternOperation is named only as the later unpacking selection.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Proof correctness is checked separately by Lean; the correspondence review compares statements, definitions and example propositions.
Abstract syntax and mathematical GC are modeled; no parser or executable collector is certified. Functions safety permits divergence.
